newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan MFIG group buys 56-60,000T corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan MFIG group buys 56-60,000T corn at tender.

text.p: Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group bought a shipment of 56,000 to 60,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Tradi Grain at a tender on Friday, traders said.
The feed group's main buyers are Taiwan's Formosa Oilseed, Fomau Cereal, Morn Sun Feed Mill and Shin Tai Industry.
The shipment was bought on a cost-and-freight basis.
Traders said the suppliers have an option to offer the shipment between 56,000 to 60,000 tonnes.
